title: Parser launch errors bypass independent graph evidence production
reasoning: When the default executor cannot launch the evaluator, FileNotFoundError or PermissionError escapes _verified_payload. The orchestrator catches only ProductionQualityError and ValueError, so it aborts before producing graph evidence instead of recording a measurement-environment eligibility reason. This contradicts the explicitly stated independence of quality and graph production. Ruff launch errors already receive the appropriate translation.
reproduction: Provide valid production inventory, readable sources, successful file rows, and a nonexistent or non-executable evaluator path with executor=None. The call raises OSError rather than returning eligibility reasons alongside graph evidence.
recommendation: Translate parser process launch OSError into ProductionQualityError with the measurement_environment_mismatch code, matching the Ruff launch handling.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included; executors returning nonzero process results do not exercise launch exceptions.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover evaluator launch failures across missing and non-executable paths, asserting an environment-mismatch eligibility reason and continued graph evidence production.
minimumFixScope: Exception translation around the process executor call in _verified_payload.
